Station walks first

Know what you’re going out for.

This pilot brings together official branch pages and point-program notices so you can check a few grocery stops before leaving the station. Walk times are the operator’s published estimates; directions use Google Maps.

Information was checked on 9 October 2026. This is a researched snapshot, not a live price feed. Flyer links open the original source. Unverified programs and item prices stay unverified. Check the store notice before paying.

The optional search uses multilingual MiniLM locally. It finds relevant notices; it cannot decide your eligibility or confirm a sale. Read the conditions shown with each result. Model & evaluation
